This figure is an attention visualization heatmap showing the self-attention mechanism within the encoder of a Transformer model, specifically in layer 5 of 6. It illustrates how the model attends to different words in a sentence when processing a particular word, in this case, "making." Colored lines emanate from the word "making" on the right to other words on the left, with each color representing a different attention head. The thickness of these lines indicates the strength of the attention assigned by that head. The visualization demonstrates that multiple attention heads correctly identify and attend to the distant word "difficult," successfully completing the long-range dependency in the phrase "making... more difficult." This highlights the Transformer's ability to capture complex syntactic and semantic relationships across several words.
